mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT s.exam_id FROM answer_sheet s INNER JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'FORMAL' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.final_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.exam_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.pass_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(1) ) t

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.exam_id) FROM answer_sheet s INNER JOIN exam e ON e.id = s.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'FORMAL' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.final_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.user_status AS userStatus, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, p.position_code AS positionCode FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT protocol_status FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
